title: 第415章 玄刹姬 我再最最最后信你一次第414章 当着玄刹姬的面连杀四人
content_zh:
第一卷第415章玄刹姬：我再最最最后信你一次！
楚枫转过身，目光落在玄清漪身上。
“还有谁？”
此话一出，玄墨、玄枯、玄烬顿时变得无比紧张。
玄烬虽是三人中最年轻的一个，此刻却抖得最厉害，双腿如同筛糠般剧烈颤动，裤裆处隐隐渗出一片湿热。
他们是真的怕了楚枫，方才他们还仗着女王大人撑腰，以为楚枫不敢在仙尊巅峰面前放肆。
可现在女王大人捂着胸口，玄雍已经变成了一具无头尸身。
楚枫是真的会杀人，更重要的是女王大人似乎根本无法阻止他。
玄清漪没有说话，只是抬起凤眸，目光从玄墨、玄枯、玄烬三人身上扫过。
那目光没有任何温度，如同在看三个死人。
这三人在危难时刻带头反叛，用护族大阵将族长和她禁锢在虚空中，逼她交出楚枫的传信玉符，还眼睁睁看着玄雍折磨玄瑶。
每一桩每一件，都够死十次。
三位长老被她这一眼看得喉咙齐齐一紧，如同被一只无形的手掐住了脖子，连呼吸都变得困难起来。
他们齐齐后退一步，背靠着背挤在一起，如同三只被逼到墙角的困兽。
玄墨第一个撑不住了，他扑通一声跪倒在地。
“老夫知错了，老夫为罗刹族立过功，为罗刹族流过血啊！”
玄烬更是直接趴在地上五体投地，带着哭腔哀嚎着。
“三长老的位置我不要了，只要留我一条命，让我做什么都行！”
楚枫抬起右手，虚空中骤然凝聚出一只遮天蔽日的金色大手。
大手从虚空中探下，五指张开，将三人攥在掌心。

三人被那只金色大手攥住，如同三只被捏在巨人掌中的蚂蚁。
可他们的修为早已被斗转星移阵抽走，哪里挣得开？
“饶命——”
楚枫五指一握，金色大手随之收拢，掌中传来三声几乎同时响起的骨骼碎裂脆响，以及一声被掐断了尾音的惨叫。
三人的身体如同三颗被捏爆的浆果，在大手掌心化作三团血雾。
形神俱灭，一个不留！
玄幽澜瞳孔骤然一震，她看着那三团尚未散尽的血雾，神色有些复杂。
她是真的没有想到，楚枫竟然如此杀伐果断。
乱世必须用重典！
罗刹族这些年在七大王族中每况愈下，正是因为族中蛀虫太多。
楚枫这一连串的杀伐看似狠辣，实则替她清除了最大的毒瘤。
下一刻，楚枫转头看向玄幽澜。
“剩下的事情，就有劳族长处置了。”
说完他抬手打了个响指，玄屠尸傀化作一道流光飞回他身旁。
他踏出一步，虚空在他脚下微微震荡，身形便已出现在百里之外，朝夜叉族的方向遁去。
既然已经灭了夜叉族的老祖，自然要斩草除根。
司冥音望着楚枫远去的背影，身形化作一道流光跟了上去。
此刻的玄刹姬几乎已经确认了心中的猜想，就算楚枫伪装得再好，可她的心魔绝对不会认错。
心念及此，她突然惨笑出声。
她怎么都没有想到，自己历经千辛万苦才从人界逃回魔界，本以为终于摆脱了那个混蛋，可以重新开始。

可还没等她喘口气，他就已经站在她面前。
“你还真是阴魂不散啊……”
玄幽澜不知何时走到了玄刹姬身旁，她顺着玄刹姬的目光望向那道已经消失在虚空尽头的身影，犹豫了好一会儿才试探性地开口道。
“女王大人，玄枫到底是什么人？”
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 415 Xuan Cha Ji: I believe in you for the last time!
Chu Feng turned around and his eyes fell on Xuan Qingyi.
"Who else?"
As soon as these words came out, Xuan Mo, Xuan Ku, and Xuan Jin suddenly became extremely nervous.
Although Xuan Jin was the youngest of the three, he was shaking the most at the moment. His legs were shaking violently like chaff, and a moist heat was faintly oozing out of his crotch.
They were really afraid of Chu Feng. Just now, they were relying on Her Majesty the Queen's support, thinking that Chu Feng would not dare to be presumptuous in front of the peak Immortal Lord.
But now the Queen is covering her chest, Xuan Yong has turned into a headless corpse.
Chu Feng can really kill people, and more importantly, Her Lady Queen seems to be unable to stop him at all.
Xuan Qingyi did not speak, but raised his phoenix eyes and swept his gaze across Xuan Mo, Xuan Ku, and Xuan Jin.
There was no warmth in his eyes, as if he were looking at three dead people.
These three people took the lead in the rebellion at the critical moment. They used the clan protection formation to imprison the clan leader and her in the void, forcing her to hand over Chu Feng's message jade talisman, and watched Xuanyong torture Xuanyao.
Every pile and piece is enough to kill you ten times.
The three elders' throats tightened at her sight, as if an invisible hand had strangled their necks, and even breathing became difficult.
They all took a step back, huddled together back to back, like three trapped animals cornered.
Xuan Mo was the first to be unable to hold on any longer and fell to his knees with a plop.
"I know I was wrong. I have made great contributions to the Rakshasa clan and shed blood for the Rakshasa clan!"
Xuan Jin lay down on the ground and wailed in a sobbing tone.
"I don't want the position of third elder anymore. As long as you keep me alive, I can do whatever you want!"
Chu Feng raised his right hand, and a big golden hand that covered the sky and the sun suddenly condensed in the void.
The big hand reached down from the void, its fingers spread out, and held the three people in the palm of its hand.
The three of them were grasped by the big golden hand, like three ants pinched in the giant's palm.
But their cultivation has long been taken away by the Star Shifting Formation, how can they break free?
"Spare your life——"
Chu Feng clenched his five fingers, then closed his big golden hand, and there were three crisp sounds of bones breaking almost simultaneously from his palm, as well as a scream that was cut off.
The bodies of the three people were like three crushed berries, turning into three masses of blood mist in the palm of the big hand.
Both body and soul are destroyed, leaving no one behind!
Xuan Youlan's pupils suddenly trembled, and she looked at the three groups of blood mist that had not yet dissipated, with a somewhat complicated look on her face.
She really didn't expect that Chu Feng would be so decisive in killing.
In troubled times, heavy scriptures must be used!
The Rakshasa clan has been deteriorating among the seven royal clans in recent years, precisely because there are too many moths in the clan.
Chu Feng's series of killings seemed cruel, but in fact they eliminated the biggest cancer for her.
The next moment, Chu Feng turned to look at Xuan Youlan.
"The rest of the matter will be handled by Patriarch Lao."
After saying that, he raised his hand and snapped his fingers, and the Xuan Tu Corpse Puppet turned into a stream of light and flew back to him.
He took a step, the void shook slightly under his feet, and his figure appeared a hundred miles away, fleeing in the direction of the Yaksha clan.
Since the ancestor of the Yasha clan has been wiped out, it is natural to eradicate the roots.
Si Mingyin looked at Chu Feng's retreating back, then turned into a stream of light and followed him.
At this moment, Xuan Cha Ji has almost confirmed the suspicion in her heart. No matter how well Chu Feng pretends, her inner demon will never admit his mistake.
Thinking of this, she suddenly burst into laughter.
She never imagined that she had gone through so much hardship to escape from the human world back to the demon world. She thought she had finally gotten rid of that bastard and could start over.
But before she could take a breath, he was already standing in front of her.
"You are really haunted..."
Xuan Youlan walked up to Xuan Chaji at some point. She followed Xuan Chaji's gaze and looked at the figure that had disappeared at the end of the void. She hesitated for a while before tentatively speaking.
"My Lady Queen, who is Xuan Feng?？”
